claims: Spring Sale drove captured payment value up
Captured payment value rose from R39.7m in August 2026 to R42.4m in September 2026, representing a change of +R2.7m (+6.7%).
The growth was led by Spring Sale · Returning with +R8.8m and Spring Sale · New with +R2.5m.
This was partially offset by drops in No promotion · Returning of -R7.4m and No promotion · New of -R1.3m.
